observations: parts_qualification.md:655 cites TPS2553 'SLVS841F equation 1 (p15, IOSmin / IOSmax)'; the cached revision G has IOSmax as eq. 1 and IOSmin as eq. 3 on pp16-17 (line 588 already cites SLVS841G pp16-17). The constants 22980 / 0.94 and 25230 / 1.016 used by r10_parts.py match, and the 1.041-1.249 A camera bound reproduces; a citation-revision detail, not a false figure.

TPS25947 note (2) (SLVSFC9C §6.1) asks for >= 350 kOhm on EN / OVLO pull-ups to IN for reverse polarity: R80 + R165 = 940 kOhm and R82 = 2 MOhm comply; D8 SMBJ12CA is bidirectional as TI recommends. Consistent, no finding.
U13 TPS70933 EN (pin 3) left open: allowed by the TPS709 datasheet (300 nA internal pull-up, 'EN can be left floating'). Consistent.
TPS7A91 is fed from PORT_5V3 (5.367-5.546 V), inside its 1.4-6.5 V range; dropout headroom about 0.66 V against 200 mV max at 1 A. Consistent.
TPS25947 recommended OVLO pin range is 0.5-1.5 V; the R82 / R83 divider gives 1.03 V at 8.4 V and stays above 0.5 V down to about 4.1 V pack, below U9's UVLO turn-off. Consistent.
